symptoms: The lower leaves start to turn a light yellow color, especially around the edges.
These leaves eventually turn bright yellow and dry out.
The leaves may break near the base and hang down around the stem.
The base of the stem splits open.
Inside the roots and stem, you will see red or brown streaks.
favourable_conditions: The disease builds up when you grow bananas in the same field over and over again.
prevention: Rotate your banana crops with paddy or sugarcane.
Plant varieties that are resistant to the wilt.
Always select healthy suckers for planting.
Make sure your field has good drainage, especially when it rains.
Do not wear footwear on your farm that has been in contact with other banana plants or soil.
practices: Remove and destroy any plant parts that are infested after you harvest.
If you find only a few infected plants, kill and chop them up.
Stew the chopped material in water at 70 degrees Celsius for 30 minutes.
Clean your machinery and tools with a sanitary solution.
Use mechanical barriers around infected plants to stop the spread.

organic_bio.text: About 60 mg of Pseudomonas fluorescens (in a capsule) can be applied in a 10 cm deep hole made in the corm.
Trichoderma viride @ 25 g for 4 times once at the time of planting in the planting pit and remaining doses at third, fifth and seventh month after planting
